options.label: Per-service duration (30/60/90/120 min)
options.description: Each service row declares its own duration. 'Group of 2' might be 90 min, 'Junior intro' 30 min, etc. Customer can't change it. Most flexible — maps cleanly to slot-based booking.

options.label: Fixed 60-min slots; coach sets total session price

options.label: Service has maxParticipants; each student books their own seat separately
options.description: 'Group of 4' creates one shared slot that 4 students can independently book a seat in, each paying pricePerSeat. New booking semantics — closer to a class signup model. Bigger code change.

questions.question: If a coach is affiliated with multiple facilities, where does the service get booked?

options.label: Service is tied to one specific court/facility
options.description: Each service row picks ONE court. Matches motifind — their service rows have specific addresses. Coach can duplicate a service across courts if needed. Simplest data model.

options.label: Service is coach-wide; customer picks a court at booking time
options.description: Service has no court binding. Customer sees coach's affiliated courts as a dropdown on the booking step. More flexible, but the per-court price overrides get messy.

options.label: Service can either be tied to a court OR be 'any affiliated court'
options.description: Hybrid — each service row has an optional court binding. If set, that's where it happens; if null, customer picks among coach's courts. Most flexible, slightly more UI.

content.text:
Good — `getCoachAvailability` already exists in `artifacts/api-server/src/lib/coach-availability.ts`, so the booking-step slot computation is solved. I have everything I need to plan precisely.

## Implementation plan

Here's the concrete plan I'd execute. Sign off and I'll start; flag anything to change.

### 1. Schema (`lib/db/src/schema/coaches.ts`)

```ts
export const coachServicesTable = pgTable("coach_services", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  coachId: integer("coach_id").notNull().references(() => coachesTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  name: text("name").notNull(),                      // "Individuali treniruotė"
  description: text("description"),                  // optional
  sport: text("sport").notNull(),                    // padel, tennis, ...
  // Optional binding: when set, this service is bookable only at that court.
  // When null, customer picks among the coach's affiliated courts at booking time.
  courtId: integer("court_id").references(() => courtsTable.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  durationMin: integer("duration_min").notNull().default(60),  // 30 | 60 | 90 | 120
  priceCents: integer("price_cents").notNull(),               // total session price
  maxParticipants: integer("max_participants").notNull().default(1),
  audienceLevel: text("audience_level"),             // optional: kids/beginners/advanced/pros
  isActive: boolean("is_active").notNull().default(true),
  sortOrder: integer("sort_order").notNull().default(0),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, t => ({ byCoach: index("coach_services_coach_idx").on(t.coachId, t.isActive) }));
```

Add to `bookingsTable`:
```ts
coachServiceId: integer("coach_service_id"),  // FK-ish, nullable
```

`pnpm push` to sync. Then a one-off seed pass that creates a "Individuali treniruotė (60 min)" service per coach using their existing `pricePerHour`, so no existing coach goes from "has a price" to "no services".

### 2. API endpoints (`artifacts/api-server/src/routes/coaches.ts` + a new `coach-services.ts`)

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /coaches/:id/services` | public | active services; filtered to `isActive=true` for non-owner viewers |
| `POST /coaches/:id/services` | owner only (`getAuth(req).userId === coach.userId`) | create |
| `PATCH /coaches/:id/services/:sid` | owner | update |
| `DELETE /coaches/:id/services/:sid` | owner | hard delete if no bookings reference it; otherwise soft-deactivate |
| `GET /coaches/:id/services/:sid/slots?date=YYYY-MM-DD` | public | free start-times that fit the service's duration on that date — uses existing `getCoachAvailability` and also intersects court availability when service is court-bound |

All responses explicitly list returned fields (no row spreads). Per-route owner check uses the verified Clerk principal.

Extend the existing booking-create endpoint to accept `coachServiceId`. Server reads the service for ground-truth price/duration/courtId — client cannot supply price.

### 3. Frontend `/coach/:id` redesign (`artifacts/courtbook/src/pages/coach.tsx`)

Visitor-facing layout (top → bottom):
1. **Hero**: photo (initials fallback), name, sport pills, city, condition icons (`✈ Atvyksta`, `📅 Lankstus`).
2. **Bio block**.
3. **Services table** — one row per active service:
   - Name + sport pill + audience (if any) + duration + maxParticipants badge
   - Court binding (or "Bet kuri aikštelė")
   - Price (right-aligned, semibold)
   - `Užsakyti` primary button per row
4. **Reviews** — stays as a placeholder for now (no data backend), keeps existing layout.
5. **Contact** fallback CTA (existing).

Clicking `Užsakyti` opens a dialog:
- Court picker (only if `service.courtId === null`; shows coach's affiliated courts as cards).
- Date picker (next 30 days).
- Time-slot grid generated from `GET /coaches/:id/services/:sid/slots?date=...`.
- Confirm → existing booking flow with `coachServiceId` set.

### 4. Coach-side service CRUD (`coach.tsx` edit-mode panel)

In the coach's own "Edit my profile" view, add a "Mano paslaugos" section:
- Table of existing services with edit/delete inline.
- "Pridėti paslaugą" → dialog with: name, sport (from coach's sports), duration select (30/60/90/120), price input (€), maxParticipants (1-8), audience level (optional), court (none / specific affiliated court), active toggle.

### 5. Tests / verification

- Typecheck after each substep.
- Booking integration tested via the agent-bypass headers (set `AGENT_BYPASS_KEY` if you want me to script an end-to-end check).
- Doc file `docs/coach-services.md` describing the data model + booking flow.

### Phasing within this conversation

I'd ship in this order, typechecking between each:
1. **Schema + migration seed**
2. **API: services CRUD + slots endpoint**
3. **`/coach/:id` services display (read-only)**
4. **Coach-side service CRUD UI**
5. **Booking dialog + integration with existing booking creation**

That's 5 distinct, individually-reviewable chunks. Each one leaves the app working end-to-end (each step adds, doesn't break).

---

**Confirm or change anything?** Specifically:
- Auto-migrate existing `pricePerHour` → default service (yes / no)?
- Keep `pricePerHour` field on coaches as legacy "starting from" hint (yes / no — recommend yes for the marketplace card "€X/val")?
- OK to start at step 1 right now, or want a smaller initial scope?

message.content:
"The implementation plan is excellent. I approve the 5-phase rollout.

To answer your specific questions:

YES, auto-migrate existing pricePerHour into a default 'Individuali treniruotė (60 min)' service.

YES, keep pricePerHour on the coachesTable to act as a denormalized "starting from" price for the marketplace cards.

YES, you are cleared to start Step 1, but you MUST enforce the following two architectural invariants throughout all 5 phases:

Invariant A: The Denormalized Price Sync
Whenever a coach creates, updates (changes price/active status), or deletes a service, you must automatically calculate their lowest active hourly rate and update the pricePerHour field on the coachesTable. The marketplace UI must never show a stale minimum price.

Invariant B: Historical Immutability
When a booking is created, the server must read coach_services.priceCents as the ground truth to calculate the Stripe charge. However, once the booking is created, it must rely entirely on the snapshotted bookings.coachAmountCents. Modifying a service's price must NEVER alter the financial data of historical or pending bookings.

Let's execute Phase 1 (Schema + Migration) and run a typecheck!"

content.text:
Acknowledged. Both invariants noted — A goes into the Phase 2 services CRUD helpers, B goes into Phase 5 booking integration. Starting Phase 1 now.

Verified live: the new GET endpoint returns JSON, the migration's "Individuali treniruotė" service is visible for coach 1 (€35, 60 min, tennis).

## Phase 2 complete ✓

**Typecheck:** clean across all packages.

**Files added:**
- `artifacts/api-server/src/lib/coach-pricing.ts` — `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, exec?)`.
- `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/coach-services.ts` — all 5 routes.

**Files edited:**
- `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts` — mounted `coachServicesRouter`.

**Transaction-boundary verification** (you asked for strict check):

| Route | Mutation | Sync | Same tx? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /coaches/:id/services` | `tx.insert(coachServicesTable)` | `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, tx)` | ✓ same `tx` from `db.transaction(async tx => {...})` |
| `PATCH /coaches/:id/services/:sid` | `tx.update(coachServicesTable)` | `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, tx)` | ✓ |
| `DELETE /coaches/:id/services/:sid` (soft) | `tx.update({ isActive: false })` | `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, tx)` | ✓ |
| `DELETE /coaches/:id/services/:sid` (hard) | `tx.delete(coachServicesTable)` | `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, tx)` | ✓ |

Any failure in either step rolls back both. Invariant A holds.

**Security checklist** (per CLAUDE.md):
- ✓ Owner enforcement via `getAuth(req).userId === coach.userId` (loadOwnedCoach) — request body / params never trusted to assert ownership.
- ✓ Object-level authz on PATCH/DELETE: re-confirms `existing.coachId === coachId` before mutating.
- ✓ `assertCoachOwnsCourt` blocks setting a foreign court id on a service.
- ✓ `formatService` projects fields explicitly — no `...row` spread.
- ✓ Non-owner GET only sees `isActive=true` services; non-approved coach's services are 404'd to non-owners.
- ✓ DELETE soft-deletes when bookings reference the service (Invariant B — booking financial snapshot in `coachAmountCents` is never affected by service mutations).

**Slots endpoint** (`GET /coaches/:id/services/:sid/slots?date=YYYY-MM-DD`):
- Loads service → uses `getCoachAvailability` for the day → if `service.courtId != null`, also subtracts court-side overlapping bookings → walks consecutive 30-min slots and returns only the start labels whose next `durationMin / 30` slots are all free.

Ready for **Phase 3 — public `/coach/:id` services display**, then **Phase 4 — coach-side service CRUD UI**, then **Phase 5 — booking dialog**. Proceed?

## Phase 4 complete ✓

**Files edited:**
- `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/coach-services.ts` — server-side 15-service catalog ceiling on POST (returns 422 `service_catalog_full`).
- `artifacts/courtbook/src/pages/coach.tsx` — services management UI.

**4.1 — Management panel** (visible when `isOwn`):
- Section header: `"Mano paslaugos"` + `Pridėti paslaugą` button (disabled when at limit) + `N/15` counter.
- Owner view renders **all** services (active + inactive) — inactive get `opacity-60` and a `<PauseCircle /> Sustabdyta` badge.
- Each row: existing flex layout + inline `Redaguoti` + `Ištrinti` buttons (icon-only on mobile via `hidden md:inline` label).
- Empty state: `"Dar neturite paslaugų. Paspauskite 'Pridėti paslaugą', kad pridėtumėte pirmąją."`

**4.2 — Upsert dialog form** (React Hook Form + zodResolver + shadcn `Form`):
- Zod schema (`serviceFormSchema`) validates: name (required, ≤120), description (≤1000), sport, duration (30/60/90/120 enum), priceEur (`/^\d+([.,]\d{1,2})?$/`), maxParticipants (1-8), audience, courtBinding, isActive.
- **Sport** Select: restricted to `coach.sports` (the coach's approved sports).
- **Duration** Select: 30 min / 1 val. / 1.5 val. / 2 val. → 30/60/90/120.
- **Price**: text input, parsed via `priceEurToCents()` (replaces "," with ".", `Math.round(eur * 100)`).
- **Max participants**: Select 1-8; `1` is labeled "1 (individualus)".
- **Audience**: Select with synthetic `__none__` for null + the 4 audience options.
- **Court binding**: Select with `__any__` for null + flattened `approvedCourtOptions` derived from `facilitiesQ.data` (each entry shows `Court name · Facility`). Server-side `assertCoachOwnsCourt` rejects any forged id; the client picker can't even render foreign courts.
- **Active**: shadcn `<Switch>`, default `true`.

**4.3 — Mutations and price sync** (Invariant A):
- `createServiceMut` → `POST /api/coaches/:id/services`
- `updateServiceMut` → `PATCH /api/coaches/:id/services/:sid`
- `deleteServiceMut` → `DELETE /api/coaches/:id/services/:sid`
- All three call `invalidateAfterServiceMutation()` on success which fires three invalidations:
  - `["coach-services", coachId]` — the services panel refetches
  - `["coach"]` (prefix) — both `["coach", id]` and `["coach", "me"]` invalidate → hero "starting from" updates
  - `["coaches"]` (prefix) — marketplace list refetches → card minimum price refreshes
- Delete uses an `AlertDialog` with confirm/cancel; toast distinguishes hard-deleted vs. soft-deactivated (when bookings reference the service, per Invariant B).

**Catalog limit (15):**
- Server: `SERVICE_CATALOG_LIMIT = 15` in `coach-services.ts`; POST counts existing rows (active + inactive) and returns 422 with `error: "service_catalog_full"` before opening the transaction.
- Client: `Pridėti paslaugą` button is `disabled` at limit, tooltip explains, counter `N/15` visible. Server error message is surfaced via toast as a defensive last line of defense.

**Typecheck:** clean across all packages (api-server, courtbook, mockup-sandbox, scripts).

**Live verification:**
- Server rebuilt and restarted on :8080.
- `GET /api/coaches/1/services` returns the migrated service (status 200).

Ready for **Phase 5 — booking dialog**: replacing `console.log("Open booking modal for:", svc.id)` with a real slot picker that hits `GET /coaches/:id/services/:sid/slots?date=…` and creates a booking with the snapshotted price (Invariant B).

Please implement this across 3 sub-phases:

--- PHASE 5.1: The Server-Side Checkout Engine Update ---
1. Update `POST /payments/create-checkout` in `routes/payments.ts`.
2. The payload must now accept `coachServiceId` (optional, for Motifind-style bookings) instead of just `coachId`.
3. If `coachServiceId` is provided:
   - Fetch the service from the DB. Verify it is active.
   - Use `service.durationMin` as the booking duration.
   - Use `service.priceCents` as the exact `coachAmountCents` (Enforcing Invariant B: Historical Immutability). The client cannot pass a price.
   - If the service is court-bound (`service.courtId != null`), force the booking to use that court. If it is floating, validate that the client-provided `courtId` is affiliated with the coach.
4. Ensure the 15-minute `pending_checkout` distributed lock is still acquired before creating the Stripe session.

--- PHASE 5.2: The Booking Dialog UI ---
1. In `pages/coach.tsx`, replace the temporary `console.log` on the 'Užsakyti' button with a state variable that opens a `<Dialog>` component (`selectedServiceForBooking`).
2. **Step 1 (Location):** If `selectedServiceForBooking.courtId` is null, render a RadioGroup of the coach's affiliated courts. The user MUST select one to proceed. If it is court-bound, skip this step or show the locked location.
3. **Step 2 (Date & Time):** Render a DatePicker (limited to the next 30 days). When a date is selected, trigger a fetch to `GET /coaches/:id/services/:sid/slots?date=YYYY-MM-DD`. Render the available start times as clickable pills.
4. **Step 3 (Summary):** Show the final Total Price (Court Price + Service Price), the location, and the selected time.

--- PHASE 5.3: The Checkout Handshake ---
1. Wire the primary "Apmokėti" (Pay) button in the summary step to call the updated `POST /payments/create-checkout` endpoint.
2. Ensure the payload passes `coachServiceId`, the selected `date`/`startTime`, and the `courtId`.
3. On success, redirect the user to the returned Stripe `checkoutUrl`.

Run strict typechecks and ensure the financial invariants hold.

options.label: Service price already includes the court — coach is on the 'coach_pays_court' model
options.description: Total = service.priceCents (no separate court add-on shown to the student); coach reimburses court owner offline. Would require this flow to honor coach.courtPaymentModel which is currently 'student_pays_court' only.

2	import { db, courtPricingTable, courtPriceOverridesTable, courtPricingRulesTable } from "@workspace/db";
3	import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
4	
5	const hd = new Holidays("LT");

7	/** Resolve the price (in EUR, per 30-min slot) for a single slot on a specific date. */
8	export async function resolvePriceForSlot(
9	  courtId: number,
10	  date: string,          // YYYY-MM-DD
11	  startTime: string,     // HH:MM
12	  defaultSlotPrice: number
13	): Promise<number> {
14	  const slotDate = new Date(`${date}T12:00:00`);
15	  const dayOfWeek = slotDate.getDay();
16	
17	  const [overrides, weeklyEntries, rules] = await Promise.all([
18	    db.select()
19	      .from(courtPriceOverridesTable)
20	      .where(and(
21	        eq(courtPriceOverridesTable.courtId, courtId),
22	        eq(courtPriceOverridesTable.date, date),
23	        eq(courtPriceOverridesTable.startTime, startTime),
24	      )),
25	    db.select()
26	      .from(courtPricingTable)
27	      .where(and(
28	        eq(courtPricingTable.courtId, courtId),
29	        eq(courtPricingTable.dayOfWeek, dayOfWeek),
30	        eq(courtPricingTable.startTime, startTime),
31	      )),
32	    db.select()
33	      .from(courtPricingRulesTable)
34	      .where(and(
35	        eq(courtPricingRulesTable.courtId, courtId),
36	        eq(courtPricingRulesTable.type, "holiday"),
37	      )),
38	  ]);
39	
40	  // 1. Date-specific override (highest priority)
41	  if (overrides.length > 0) return Number(overrides[0].price);
42	
43	  // 2. Holiday rule — only when the date is a public holiday
44	  const isHoliday = !!hd.isHoliday(slotDate);
45	  if (isHoliday && rules.length > 0) return Number(rules[0].price);
46	
47	  // 3. Weekly recurring template
48	  if (weeklyEntries.length > 0) return Number(weeklyEntries[0].price);
49	
50	  // 4. Default fallback
51	  return defaultSlotPrice;
52	}
53	
54	/**

56	 * instead of per-slot. Used in the availability endpoint.
57	 */

59	  courtId: number,
60	  date: string,
61	  defaultSlotPrice: number
62	): Promise<{ priceMap: Map<string, number>; isHoliday: boolean }> {
63	  try {
64	    return await _buildDayPriceMap(courtId, date, defaultSlotPrice);

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user has been progressively building a motifind-style coach services system on Korts.lt (Lithuanian sports court booking platform). The conversation began with bug fixes on the coach map (zoom-out issue, multi-coach cluster InfoWindow), moved through find-a-coach card UI improvements and time slider redesign, then pivoted to the major architectural work: implementing motifind.lt's service catalog pattern adapted to Korts.lt's existing time-slot reservation system. This work has been executed across 5 phases, with Phase 5 (Interactive Booking Dialog & Checkout Bridge) being the current focus. The user explicitly chose: (a) New POST /api/coach-bookings endpoint with strict separation of concerns; (b) Use existing status='pending' + cron sweep pattern (no new distributed lock); (c) Charge court price + service price with coachAmountCents storing ONLY service.priceCents.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL with `pnpm push` (no migration files)
   - Two enforced architectural invariants:
     - Invariant A: Denormalized pricePerHour sync via `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, tx)`
     - Invariant B: Historical immutability — `bookings.coachAmountCents` snapshotted from `service.priceCents`, never recomputed
   - Express 5 routes with `requireAuth`, `getCurrentUserId`, `clerkClient.users.getUser()` patterns
   - Existing `getCoachAvailability` helper for 30-min slot matrix checks
   - `resolvePriceForSlot` for court pricing (per-slot EUR)
   - React Hook Form + Zod + shadcn/ui (Dialog, AlertDialog, Form, Select, Switch)
   - TanStack Query with cache invalidation across `["coach-services"]`, `["coach"]`, `["coaches"]` prefixes
   - 15-service catalog limit (server returns 422 `service_catalog_full`)
   - Integer cents pattern for money (Math.round for euro→cents conversion)
   - Stripe Connect with `transfer_data` (coach gets `service.priceCents` via separate post-payment transfer)

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - `lib/db/src/schema/coaches.ts`
     - Added `coachServicesTable` with: id, coachId, name, description, sport, courtId (nullable), durationMin, priceCents, maxParticipants, audienceLevel, isActive, sortOrder, createdAt, updatedAt
     - Exported `CoachService` type

   - `lib/db/src/schema/bookings.ts`
     - Added `coachServiceId: integer("coach_service_id")` nullable column

   - `scripts/src/migrate-coach-default-services.ts` (new)
     - Created 17 default services from existing pricePerHour values, one per (coach, sport)
     - Registered as `pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run migrate-coach-default-services`

   - `artifacts/api-server/src/lib/coach-pricing.ts` (new)
     - `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, exec)` helper
     - Reads MIN(priceCents) WHERE isActive=true, writes to coachesTable.pricePerHour
     - Sets to 0 when no active services
     - Type: `CoachPricingExecutor = typeof db | Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0]`

   - `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/coach-services.ts` (new)
     - 5 endpoints: GET (public/owner-aware), POST, PATCH, DELETE, GET slots
     - 15-service limit enforced before insert
     - All mutations wrap with `db.transaction` + `syncCoachStartingPrice(coachId, tx)`
     - DELETE soft-deactivates when bookings reference the service (Invariant B)
     - GET slots uses `getCoachAvailability` + court-availability intersection for court-bound services
     - Uses tagged union `LoadedCoach` for type-safe auth
     - Pattern: `parseInt(String(req.params.id), 10)` for type safety

   - `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/coach-bookings.ts` (NEW - most recent file)
     - `GET /coach-bookings/quote` — price breakdown preview (no insert)
     - `POST /coach-bookings` — creates status='pending' booking, returns bookingId + breakdown
     - Shared `resolveCoachBookingWindow()` validation pipeline
     - Validates: service active, coach approved/accepting/Stripe-active, court binding (forced if service.courtId set; else affiliated check), coach matrix coverage, court overlap check, court price via `resolvePriceForSlot`

content.text:
## Phase 5 — Interactive Booking Dialog & Checkout Bridge

### 5.1 — Server endpoint (`coach-bookings.ts`)
- New `POST /api/coach-bookings` creates a `status='pending'` booking row using only `{ coachServiceId, courtId?, date, startTime }` from the client.
- New `GET /api/coach-bookings/quote` returns the same priced breakdown without inserting — used to power the dialog's live summary.
- Shared `resolveCoachBookingWindow()` validates: service active; coach approved/accepting/Stripe-active; court forced from `service.courtId` (or affiliation-checked if floating); coach matrix coverage; court overlap; court price via `resolvePriceForSlot`.
- Snapshots on insert (Invariant B): `coachAmountCents = service.priceCents`, `coachServiceId = service.id`, `coachId = coach.userId`, `totalPrice = (courtCents + serviceCents) / 100`.

### 5.2 — Booking dialog (`pages/coach.tsx`)
- Užsakyti now opens a `<Dialog>` instead of `console.log`.
- Three sections: **(1) Vieta** — locked court for bound services, `RadioGroup` of approved courts for floating; **(2) Data ir laikas** — `DateCalendar` popover + slot pills fetched from `/coaches/:id/services/:sid/slots`; **(3) Suvestinė** — live quote with `Aikštelė + Paslauga → Iš viso` breakdown.
- Added `slotsQ` and `quoteQ` TanStack queries plus `formatLocalYmd()` helper to avoid UTC drift.

### 5.3 — Checkout handshake
- Apmokėti chains two awaits: `POST /coach-bookings` → `POST /payments/create-checkout` → `window.location.href = checkout.url`. Button disables and shows a `Loader2` spinner during the round-trip.
- `payments.ts` now branches on `booking.coachServiceId`: when set, it sources `coachCents`, `coachUserId`, and `courtCents` from the snapshotted booking columns instead of re-running `authorizeAndPriceCoach` (preserves Invariant B). Stripe `transfer_data` logic untouched — both paths gate on a new `hasCoachAttachment` flag and produce the same split.
- The post-Stripe DB update only re-writes coach columns on the legacy path (`writeCoachOnBooking`), never overwriting the coach-service snapshot.

`pnpm typecheck` clean across all packages.
